NOTES TO SUMMARY OF UNAUDITED CONSOLIDATED NET INCOME
Note A - Revenues for the nine months ended September 30, 1996 and 1995 were $4.6 billion and for the three months then ended were $1.6 billion.

Note B - The provisions for taxes on income for the nine months ended September 30, 1996 and 1995 were $66.6 million and $169.2 million. For the three months ended September 30,1996 and 1995 taxes on income resulted in a benefit of $48.1 million and a provision of $33.3 million.

Note C - Earnings per share are based on the weighted average number of shares outstanding for the nine months ended September 30, 1996 and 1995 of 66,802,000 and 68,949,000 after deduction of preferred dividends. Shares outstanding at September 30, 1996 and 1995 were 64,702,000 and 68,336,000. Subsequent to September 30, 1996 Transamerica issued 1,571,000 shares of its common stock in connection with the acquisition of Trans Ocean Ltd.

Note D - On March 27, 1996 the Life Insurance operation exchanged $429.3 million of non investment grade bond investments for a like amount of higher rated notes issued by a subsidiary of Transamerica Corporation (parent company). The exchange resulted in a $9.1 million gain on investment transactions at the Life Insurance operation, which gain was eliminated in consolidation. This transaction had no effect on the consolidated financial statements of Transamerica Corporation.
